customer.sentenceEn: André believes this benefits both her business and her customers .
customer.translationZh: 安德烈认为这对她的生意和客户都有好处。
customer.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第12句

customer.sentenceEn: They visit the store so much that staff have been forced to put up signs, asking their customers not to feed them.
customer.translationZh: 它们光顾这家店的次数太多，以至于店员不得不张贴告示，要求顾客不要投喂它们。
customer.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第11句

customer.sentenceEn: In the study, the bigger display of jams leads to lower customer satisfaction than the smaller display.
customer.translationZh: 研究表明，展示的果酱种类越多，顾客满意度反而低于种类较少的展示。
customer.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

customer.sentenceEn: We assume that if we offer our customers more choices, then they'll be more likely to buy our products.
customer.translationZh: 我们认为，如果给客户提供更多选择，他们就更有可能购买我们的产品。
customer.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

customer.sentenceEn: A businesswoman said her business dropped sharply when parking space gave way to a bike lane, because most of her customers came by car.
customer.translationZh: 一位女企业家表示，当停车位被自行车道取代后，她的生意大幅下滑，因为她的绝大多数顾客都是开车来的。

customer.sentenceEn: There are situations where customers buy nothing.
customer.translationZh: 有些情况下，顾客什么都不会买。

career.sentenceEn: Martin Neil Baily, an economist who is leading a research project on retirement security, notes that quitting a career can lead to feelings of isolation and loneliness, particularly for men.
career.translationZh: 负责领导退休保障研究项目的经济学家马丁·尼尔·贝利指出，结束职业生涯可能会导致孤立感和孤独感，对男性而言尤其如此。
career.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第1句

career.sentenceEn: Twelve years into his career , Mark Long, a radiotherapy physicist with the NHS in Surrey, doesn't get as much gaming time as he used to.
career.translationZh: 马克·朗（Mark Long）在萨里郡的英国国家医疗服务体系（NHS）担任放射物理师。职业生涯已走过十二载的他，现在的游戏时间大不如前了。

career.sentenceEn: Playing games casually is unlikely to help your career prospects.
career.translationZh: 随性地玩游戏不太可能对你的职业前景有所帮助。

career.sentenceEn: Those who had successfully changed careers after 45 told Generation that education and training had been a big help — and that included in-person, on-the-job training, "informal learning," and online courses — with or without certification.
career.translationZh: 那些在45岁以后成功转行的人告诉Generation组织，教育和培训起到了很大帮助——这包括面授培训、在职培训、“非正式学习”以及在线课程，无论是否获得认证。

career.sentenceEn: People who had succeeded in career change after 45 told a nonprofit organization they owed a great deal to the education and training they had received.
career.translationZh: 那些在45岁以后成功实现职业转型的人告诉一家非营利组织，这在很大程度上归功于他们所接受的教育和培训。

career.sentenceEn: They take great pride in their chosen career .
career.translationZh: 他们对自己选择的职业感到非常自豪。

case.sentenceEn: Modesty may be key when cooperation is essential, but the researchers also found that in some cases , status signaling has advantages.
case.translationZh: 在合作至关重要的情况下，谦逊或许是关键，但研究人员也发现，在某些情况下，彰显地位会更具优势。
case.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第6句

case.sentenceEn: But this is not the case with fruit juice.
case.translationZh: 但果汁的情况并非如此。

case.sentenceEn: The study found that while the bigger display table created more interest, people were almost 10 times less likely to purchase a jar of jam than in the case of the smaller display.
case.translationZh: 研究发现，虽然更大的展示台能吸引更多兴趣，但人们购买果酱的可能性却比小展示台的情况低了近十倍。
case.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

case.sentenceEn: In an extensive study published in 2015, researchers analyzed a total of 99 choice studies and specifically looked at those cases in which reducing choices helped to boost sales.
case.translationZh: 在2015年发表的一项广泛研究中，研究人员分析了总共99项选择研究，并特别关注了减少选择有助于提高销售额的那些案例。
case.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第4句

case.sentenceEn: New policies adopted by many US schools require students to do online learning at home in case of a school closure.
case.translationZh: 美国多所学校采用的新政策要求，若学校关闭，学生须在家进行在线学习。

case.sentenceEn: It has helped solve several murder cases .
case.translationZh: 它帮助破获了数起谋杀案。

consumer.sentenceEn: Identifying why the fast-fashion business model creates waste and determining whether regulators can establish incentives for consumers and manufacturers are steps to reduce waste.
consumer.translationZh: 找出快时尚商业模式产生浪费的原因，并确定监管机构是否可以为消费者和制造商制定激励措施，这些都是减少浪费的步骤。
consumer.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

consumer.sentenceEn: The researchers put forth policy contributions, ranging from sustainable disposal of leftover stock to production tax to incentivize both manufacturers and consumers to be more waste conscious.
consumer.translationZh: 研究人员提出了多项政策建议，包括可持续处理库存积压产品和征收生产税，以激励制造商和消费者提高浪费意识。
consumer.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

consumer.sentenceEn: Manufacturers, consumers , and regulatory bodies can then take an informed approach to recognize the environmental impact of fast-fashion and to design an ecosystem to reduce waste, incentivize innovation, and create new business models to manage waste.
consumer.translationZh: 制造商、消费者和监管机构便能采取知情策略，认识快时尚对环境的影响，并构建一个减少浪费、激励创新、创造废物管理新商业模式的生态系统。
consumer.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

consumer.sentenceEn: Freshly juiced fruit has become a basic dietary item—especially for busy, health-conscious consumers who can save time on making (and perhaps even chewing) their food without missing out on nutrients.
consumer.translationZh: 鲜榨果汁已成为基本饮食项目——尤其受到忙碌且注重健康的消费者青睐，他们可以节省制作（甚至咀嚼）食物的时间，同时又不会错过营养。

consumer.sentenceEn: What do we learn about consumers buying Beyond Burger and Impossible Foods products?
consumer.translationZh: 关于购买Beyond Burger和Impossible Foods产品的消费者，我们了解到什么信息？

consumer.sentenceEn: It escapes regulation and misleads consumers .
consumer.translationZh: 它规避监管并误导消费者。

community.sentenceEn: "Over at Game Academy, Mr Barrie is aware they still have a mountain to climb. The employer community will need the science," he says, but confesses he only became a true believer when he started asking players about their biggest in-game achievements.
community.translationZh: 在游戏学院（Game Academy），巴里先生意识到他们仍有重任在肩。他表示：“雇主群体需要这些科学数据”，但他坦言，直到他开始询问玩家在游戏中的最大成就时，他才真正成为了这一理念的信徒。

community.sentenceEn: The people least interested in retraining are more likely to come from historically disadvantaged communities , more likely to have low incomes, and are more likely to have the least schooling after getting their high-school diploma or earlier.
community.translationZh: 最缺乏再培训意愿的人群，往往更有可能来自历史上的弱势社区，更有可能收入偏低，且更有可能在高中毕业或更早之后就再未接受过教育。

community.sentenceEn: Our guest today is a popular blog writer and a major figure in the tiny home community .
community.translationZh: 今天的嘉宾是一位受欢迎的博客作者，也是小房子社区的重要人物。
community.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

community.sentenceEn: They can make unlovely spaces lovely, and marry use and beauty as well as help promote a sense of community .
community.translationZh: 它们能让原本不起眼的空间变得美丽动人，将实用性与美感完美结合，同时还有助于增强社区归属感。
community.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

community.sentenceEn: The Fayetteville native believes driving a school bus allows her to give back to her community .
community.translationZh: 这位费耶特维尔本地人认为，驾驶校车让她能够回馈自己的社区。

challenge.sentenceEn: Designed by a group of six Year 9 and Year 10 boys from Finchley Catholic High School, the toy was the winning entry in the museum's 2015 Design Ventura competition, which brings the business of design to life for students aged 13 to 16 by challenging them to develop a new creative, sustainable and commercially feasible product for the Design Museum shop and attracts hundreds of entries nationwide.
challenge.translationZh: 这款玩具由芬奇利天主教高中的六名九年级和十年级男生设计，是该博物馆2015年"设计 Ventura"竞赛的获奖作品。该竞赛旨在为13至16岁的学生生动展现设计行业，通过挑战他们为设计博物馆商店开发具有创新性、可持续性和商业可行性的新产品，每年吸引全国数百份参赛作品。

challenge.sentenceEn: This little story turns out to be a fascinating glimpse at the challenges cities face as they try to update their urban infrastructure — to clean up the air, reduce greenhouse emissions, and speed up travel by making towns more bike-friendly.
challenge.translationZh: 这个小故事生动地展示了城市在更新基础设施时所面临的挑战——即通过打造自行车友好型城镇，来净化空气、减少温室气体排放并提高出行效率。

challenge.sentenceEn: Higher education is a great way to equip yourself with some core skills, but it will not prepare you for actual challenges you'll face with clients' work.
challenge.translationZh: 高等教育是装备核心技能的绝佳途径，但它并不能让你完全准备好应对实际工作中来自客户的挑战。
challenge.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

challenge.sentenceEn: This began a journey to transform our practice and challenge the ways of learning for a group of Year 6 students used to sitting in desks and rows for years.
challenge.translationZh: 由此开启了一段转型之旅，我们开始改变教学实践，并挑战一群六年级学生的学习方式，而这些学生多年来早已习惯了坐在成排的课桌前学习。
challenge.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

challenge.sentenceEn: Participants in Design Ventura are challenged to create sustainable and marketable products.
challenge.translationZh: 设计创想大赛（Design Ventura）的参与者需要挑战设计出可持续且具有市场潜力的产品。

concern.sentenceEn: Many other designers and architects have expressed concern over the future supply of home-grown talent for UK firms, and industry bodies have pointed out that there has been a lack of roots-level support.
concern.translationZh: 许多其他设计师和建筑师对英国公司本土人才的未来供应表示担忧，行业机构也指出，在基层支持方面存在不足。

concern.sentenceEn: If caught, the snake would be examined to determine where it came from, how long it had been in the area, what it had been eating, whether it was carrying any diseases of concern and whether it had produced babies.
concern.translationZh: 如果这条蛇被抓获，研究人员将对其进行检查，以确定其来源、在该地区出没的时长、其摄食情况、是否携带相关疾病以及是否已经繁育后代。
concern.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

concern.sentenceEn: Earth Day now brings together citizens and activists from around the world to raise awareness and take action regarding such environmental concerns as global warming and renewable energy.
concern.translationZh: 现在，地球日汇聚了来自世界各地的民众和活动人士，共同提高公众意识，并针对全球变暖和可再生能源等环境问题采取行动。
concern.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

concern.sentenceEn: This is confirmed by a recent poll that found that, for half of hourly workers, their top concern is not that they work too much but that they work too little.
concern.translationZh: 最近的一项民意调查证实了这一点，该调查发现，对于一半的小时工来说，他们最关心的不是工作太多，而是工作太少。

concern.sentenceEn: In the U.S. labor market, the primary concern of people with less schooling and fewer skills is to secure any employment even if it is low-paid.
concern.translationZh: 在美国劳动力市场中，受教育程度较低、技能较少的人群最关心的是找到任何工作，即使是低薪工作。
这一直是消费者关注的问题。

contribute.sentenceEn: And extra calories can contribute to weight gain.
contribute.translationZh: 额外的卡路里会导致体重增加。

contribute.sentenceEn: Most foods containing fructose—a naturally occurring sugar found in all fruits and fruit juices—don't seem to have harmful effects as long as they're not contributing to excess daily calories.
contribute.translationZh: 大多数含有果糖（一种存在于所有水果和果汁中的天然糖分）的食物，只要不导致每日热量摄入过剩，似乎就不会产生有害影响。

contribute.sentenceEn: Aside from the link to type 2 diabetes, many studies agree that fruit juice is harmful if it contributes to an excess in calories.
contribute.translationZh: 除了与2型糖尿病有关联外，许多研究一致认为，如果果汁导致热量摄入过剩，那么它是有害的。

contribute.sentenceEn: Both scenarios(情况) are contributing to a big increase in the number of people in the U.S. working into their 70s.
contribute.translationZh: 这两种情况都导致了美国 70 岁以上仍在工作的人数大幅增加。
contribute.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

contribute.sentenceEn: A physicist admits gaming has contributed to his computer knowledge and skills of solving problems.
contribute.translationZh: 一位物理学家承认，电子游戏有助于提升他的计算机知识以及解决问题的能力。

contribute.sentenceEn: It has contributed a great deal to human flights to space.
contribute.translationZh: 它为人类的太空飞行做出了巨大贡献。

current.sentenceEn: I tell you, my current commute is killing me.
current.translationZh: 跟你说，我现在的通勤简直要了我的命。
current.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第10段，第2句

current.sentenceEn: Considering the huge impact they have had on our current society, it is without doubt that we can expect them to continue to remain important for centuries to come.
current.translationZh: 考虑到它们对当今社会产生的巨大影响，毫无疑问，它们在未来几个世纪仍将继续保持重要地位。
current.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

current.sentenceEn: Everything from specialist cheeses to sought-after coffee beans gets thrown away every day in the current food system.
current.translationZh: 在当前的食品体系中，从特制奶酪到备受追捧的咖啡豆，各种食品每天都在被丢弃。
current.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第6句

current.sentenceEn: Companies such as Impossible Foods and Beyond Meat—the current superstars of the alternative protein sector—are pursuing consumers who enjoy meat but want to reduce their meat consumption for animal rights, health, or environmental reasons.
current.translationZh: 像Impossible Foods和Beyond Meat这样的公司——它们是当前替代蛋白领域的超级明星——正在争取那些喜欢吃肉但出于动物权益、健康或环境原因希望减少肉类消费的消费者。
current.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

current.sentenceEn: When making decisions, we give priority to our current frame of mind without thinking much of the consequences.

current.sentenceEn: It tries to escape the constraints of the current food system.
current.translationZh: 它试图摆脱当前食品体系的限制。

connection.sentenceEn: The arrests were in connection with a string of mail thefts from U.S. Postal Service's collection boxes in Marion County and for the possession of a stolen postal key, according to the Department of Justice.
connection.translationZh: 美国司法部表示，这些逮捕行动与马里恩县发生的一系列美国邮政局邮箱盗窃案有关，同时也涉及持有被盗的邮政钥匙。
connection.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

connection.sentenceEn: While our initial attraction may be based, in part, on physical chemistry, it is the meeting of our inner worlds that creates the lasting intimacy and spiritual connection for which we long.
connection.translationZh: 虽然我们最初的吸引力可能部分源于身体层面的化学反应，但正是我们内心世界的交汇，才创造了我们渴望的持久亲密关系和精神连接。
connection.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第1句

connection.sentenceEn: The human brain has the ability to constantly form new networks and connections between brain cells.
connection.translationZh: 人脑具有不断形成脑细胞间新网络和连接的能力。
connection.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

connection.sentenceEn: Many of us spend far too much time, energy, and money trying to polish an image of what we think will bring attention, love, and connection .
connection.translationZh: 我们很多人花费了太多的时间、精力和金钱，试图打造一个我们认为能吸引关注、赢得喜爱并建立联系的形象。
connection.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

connection.translationZh: 是什么带来了心灵的连接？

connection.sentenceEn: They are better able to gain attention, love, and personal connection .
connection.translationZh: 他们更善于获得关注、喜爱和建立人际关系。

climate.sentenceEn: Maybe bike lanes will always be charged with emotion, until enough of the public is finally concerned about climate change — and it seems reckless(鲁莽的) to not have them.
climate.translationZh: 也许自行车道的修建始终会带有情绪色彩，直到公众对气候变化的关注达到一定程度，以至于不修建自行车道会被视为一种鲁莽行为。

climate.sentenceEn: The fierce divide between store owners and bike-lane advocates seems similar to our larger culture wars over climate change.
climate.translationZh: 店主与自行车道支持者之间的激烈分歧，似乎与我们在气候变化问题上更大规模的文化战争如出一辙。

climate.sentenceEn: "In view of the climate crisis, I didn't want to open the same restaurant," Humm told the Financial Times in an interview.
climate.translationZh: “鉴于气候危机，我不想再开一家同样的餐厅，”胡姆在接受《金融时报》采访时表示。
climate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

climate.sentenceEn: These include nutrient intake, sun exposure, climate , and disease exposure varying across the course of the year.
climate.translationZh: 这些因素包括全年变化的营养摄入、日照时间、气候条件和疾病接触情况。

climate.sentenceEn: A number of existing farming technologies could be used to reduce the negative effect of climate change on food production.
climate.translationZh: 多项现有农业技术可用于减轻气候变化对粮食生产的负面影响。

climate.sentenceEn: They have difficulty adapting to climate change.
climate.translationZh: 它们难以适应气候变化。

cooking.sentenceEn: "Their cooking is elevated to an art form and some of their dishes are destined to become classics," reads Michelin's website, in a clear nod to plant-based foods' growing significance in the culinary(烹饪的) world.

cooking.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第8段，第2句

cooking.translationZh: 这种信心的变化可能会带来家庭烹饪中的性别平衡。

cooking.sentenceEn: At the end of the program, cooking confidence and skills were equal across both counterparts.
cooking.translationZh: 课程结束时，男女参与者的烹饪信心和技能水平相当。

cooking.sentenceEn: New research has studied the effects of a seven-week healthy cooking course.
cooking.translationZh: 新研究探讨了一项为期七周的健康烹饪课程所产生的效果。

cooking.sentenceEn: What do we learn about the benefits the participants gained from the healthy cooking course?

cooking.translationZh: 它将这家餐厅的烹饪提升到了艺术的高度。

calorie.sentenceEn: It particularly comes with risks when we consume more than 150ml of free sugars per day, or when it puts us over our recommended calorie intake.

calorie.sentenceEn: And extra calories can contribute to weight gain.
calorie.translationZh: 额外的卡路里会导致体重增加。

calorie.sentenceEn: So while we know that fruit juice can cause diabetes if it's part of a diet that has more calories overall, it's less clear how juice affects the long-term health of those who aren't overweight.
calorie.translationZh: 因此，虽然我们知道如果果汁是总体热量较高饮食的一部分，它可能会导致糖尿病，但对于体重正常的人群来说，果汁如何影响其长期健康则不太明确。

calorie.sentenceEn: He found negative effects on blood sugar and insulin levels when food provided excess calories from sugars, including fruit juice.
calorie.translationZh: 他发现，当食物（包括果汁）中的糖分提供过多热量时，会对血糖和胰岛素水平产生负面影响。

calorie.sentenceEn: A lot of research comes to the same conclusion that fruit juice does harm to the human body when it leads to surplus calories .

consequence.sentenceEn: When making decisions, we give priority to our current frame of mind without thinking much of the consequences .

cash.sentenceEn: Your proposal to pay cash rewards to students who get good grades is a particular problem.

cash.sentenceEn: It seems like you'd have the same problems with cash .

conclude.sentenceEn: The experts concluded that pandas should ideally "be happy enough to thrive, but not so content that they don't want to move around and find new mates".

conclude.sentenceEn: It concluded that pandas fail to wander off in search of new mates if they find their habitat too comfortable, resulting in a lack of vital genetic diversity.

conclude.sentenceEn: Sievenpiper concludes that the recommended 150ml of fruit juice per day, which is an average serving, is reasonable.

conclude.sentenceEn: ("Fears of disastrous consequences for local businesses are unfounded," the researchers concluded .)

conclude.sentenceEn: What can we conclude from the new research by scientists at Michigan State University?

credit.sentenceEn: He credits his success to his family, his strong desire to run his own business — and "a damn good company in Iceland that made a damn good game".
credit.translationZh: 他将自己的成功归功于家庭、自己创业的强烈愿望，以及“冰岛那家做出了一款极其出色游戏的一流公司”。

credit.sentenceEn: Instead, he credits old-school games like Palace of Magic with exposing him to computers.

credit.sentenceEn: M: Maybe you're right, but the credit card has a very good special offer, where I don't pay any interest for six months.
credit.translationZh: 男：也许你说得对，但是这张信用卡有个特别优惠，六个月内不用付任何利息。

completely.sentenceEn: Eventually, the cars far behind are forced to stop completely or risk hitting the slower vehicles ahead—and so the traffic grinds to a halt over nothing, Horn said.

completely.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

completely.sentenceEn: This need to be liked can be traced back to when we were children and were completely dependent on others to take care of us: Small children are not just learning how to walk and communicate, they are also trying to learn how the world works.

completely.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

completely.translationZh: 它与其他户外运动截然不同。

creativity.sentenceEn: They have a wonderful arts program that would really challenge Jake in terms of creativity and imagination.

creativity.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第3句

creativity.sentenceEn: EVE teaches skills like creativity , leadership, organisation, and conflict resolution, he maintains.
creativity.translationZh: 他坚持认为，EVE 能够培养诸如创造力、领导力、组织能力以及冲突解决能力等技能。

creativity.sentenceEn: For every one of the five studies, they found the same thing—participants who cheated in the first task did better on the creativity task.
creativity.translationZh: 在五项研究中的每一项里，他们都发现了同样的结果——在第一项任务中作弊的参与者在创造力任务中表现更好。

creativity.sentenceEn: In addition to benefits for creativity , deviance can be a good thing in other ways.
creativity.translationZh: 除了对创造力有益外，偏离常规在其他方面也可能是件好事。

creativity.sentenceEn: The researchers tested the participants' creativity by asking them to play a word game.
creativity.translationZh: 研究人员通过让参与者玩文字游戏来测试他们的创造力。

creativity.sentenceEn: Engage students with challenging tasks to foster their creativity .
creativity.translationZh: 让学生参与具有挑战性的任务，以培养他们的创造力。

crop.sentenceEn: Similarly, in this unconventional experiment, scientists will make tiny, precise changes to the DNA of the seedlings to make the cocoa crops survive in warmer and drier climates.
crop.translationZh: 同样，在这项非常规实验中，科学家们将对幼苗的DNA进行微小而精确的改变，以使可可作物能够在更温暖和干燥的气候中存活。
crop.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第3句

crop.sentenceEn: Yet knowing when it's going to rain is vital for farmers wanting to sow seeds, irrigate crops or take their animals out to the fields to feed on grass.
crop.translationZh: 然而，对于农民而言，了解何时会下雨至关重要——他们需要根据雨情来播种、灌溉庄稼，或是赶牲畜到田里吃草。

crop.sentenceEn: Cotton doesn't have to go, since it is, after all, one of the most useful cash crops across the globe.
crop.translationZh: 棉花并非必须被淘汰，毕竟它仍是全球最有用的经济作物之一。
crop.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

crop.sentenceEn: Other studies, including studies of wheat in India and corn in Africa, also found that there is a threshold above which yields sharply decline: crops can adapt and move, but only to a point.
crop.translationZh: 其他研究，包括对印度小麦和非洲玉米的研究，也发现存在一个临界点，超过这个温度，产量就会急剧下降：作物可以适应环境并迁移，但这种适应和迁移是有限度的。

crop.sentenceEn: Some studies indicate that horticulture crops —generally, everything besides staples—may be impacted most severely, largely because they tend to be confined to a smaller geographic area.
crop.translationZh: 一些研究表明，园艺作物——通常指除主食以外的所有作物——可能受到最严重的影响，这主要是因为它们往往局限在较小的地理区域内种植。

crop.sentenceEn: A recent news report talked about scientific efforts to help crops survive droughts through genetic engineering.
crop.translationZh: 最近一则新闻报道了通过基因工程帮助作物抵御干旱的科学努力。

crisis.sentenceEn: Crises , after all, have a way of opening people's eyes to possibilities.
crisis.translationZh: 毕竟，危机总是有办法让人们洞察到新的可能。

crisis.sentenceEn: "In view of the climate crisis , I didn't want to open the same restaurant," Humm told the Financial Times in an interview.
crisis.translationZh: “鉴于气候危机，我不想再开一家同样的餐厅，”胡姆在接受《金融时报》采访时表示。
crisis.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

crisis.sentenceEn: Unfortunately, the crisis of global warming has already had a serious negative impact on cacao farms' yields, leading to the prices of chocolates skyrocketing.
crisis.translationZh: 不幸的是，全球变暖危机已对可可农场的产量造成严重负面影响，导致巧克力价格飙升。
crisis.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

crisis.sentenceEn: As the world migrant crisis intensifies, employment is becoming a global concern.
crisis.translationZh: 随着全球移民危机的加剧，就业问题正成为一项全球性关切。
crisis.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

crisis.sentenceEn: When people have no way out in crises , they are more likely to embrace changes.
crisis.translationZh: 当人们在危机中走投无路时，往往更倾向于拥抱变革。

crisis.sentenceEn: They could calm people down a bit in times of crisis .
crisis.translationZh: 在危机时刻，它们可以让人稍微平静一些。

cultivate.sentenceEn: We may develop a habit of being so focused on maintaining a perfect appearance that we never cultivate the inner qualities necessary to sustain and deepen intimacy and connection.

cultivate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

cultivate.sentenceEn: The path toward cultivating inner beauty is really simple.
cultivate.translationZh: 培养内在美的途径其实很简单。

cultivate.sentenceEn: If we redirect our attention toward cultivating inner qualities, we might find a magnetic attraction that moves us from something superficial to something that connects us to our depths.
cultivate.translationZh: 如果我们将注意力转向培养内在品质，或许会发现一种强大的吸引力，引导我们从表面的事物走向能与我们内心深处相连的东西。

cultivate.sentenceEn: In April 1649, locals responded to high prices and food shortages by cultivating vegetables on common land in Southern England.

council.sentenceEn: Additionally, recycling facilities may be improved at a local council level and recycled plastic could be imported.

council.sentenceEn: Why did City Council member Anna Cumber advocate the introduction of electric bikes into Jacksonville?

capture.sentenceEn: The snake was eventually captured by the local animal handlers and taken to an animal hospital afterward.
capture.translationZh: 这条蛇最终被当地的动物处理人员捕获，随后被送往一家动物医院。

competitive.sentenceEn: But participants were more likely to choose that person when they're looking for a competitive team member.
competitive.translationZh: 但当参与者在寻找有竞争力的团队成员时，他们更有可能选择那个人。

competitive.sentenceEn: He believes giving out this information will help Ohio's colleges and universities to be more competitive .

complex.sentenceEn: New findings suggest that the kinds of complex and strategic self-presentation behaviour we see in adults appear at a much younger age than previously known.
complex.translationZh: 新发现表明，我们在成年人身上看到的那种复杂且具有策略性的自我展示行为，出现的年龄比之前所知要早得多。
complex.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

complex.sentenceEn: They found four rules that motivate consumers to buy: when people want to make a quick and easy choice, when the product is complex , when it's difficult to compare alternatives, and when consumers don't have clear preferences.
complex.translationZh: 他们发现了促使消费者购买的四个规则：当人们希望做出快速简便的选择时，当产品较为复杂时，当难以比较替代品时，以及当消费者没有明确偏好时。
complex.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第5句

complex.sentenceEn: How accurate DNA tests are relies greatly upon the kind of test being taken, on the specific question you ask, and on how complex the genetics behind a trait(特征) is.
complex.translationZh: DNA检测的准确性在很大程度上取决于所进行的检测类型、你所提出的具体问题，以及该特征背后遗传基因的复杂程度。
complex.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

complex.sentenceEn: Good stories can contain multiple meanings, so they're surprisingly economical in conveying complex ideas in graspable ways.
complex.translationZh: 好故事可以承载多重含义，因此它们能用易于理解的方式传递复杂思想，效率之高令人惊叹。
complex.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第4句

complex.sentenceEn: Students now write longer and more complex essays than their counterparts in previous decades while the error rates remain unchanged.

complex.sentenceEn: End users, young and old alike, find the terms complex to interpret.
complex.translationZh: 无论是年轻人还是老年人，终端用户都觉得这些术语难以理解。

classical.sentenceEn: Classical music and opera are the very foundation of what our modern music is based upon.
classical.translationZh: 古典音乐和歌剧是现代音乐的基石。
classical.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

classical.sentenceEn: Fans of classical music can also tell you that there are few types of music that are more expressive.
classical.translationZh: 古典音乐爱好者也会告诉你，几乎没有哪种音乐比古典音乐更具表现力。
classical.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

classical.sentenceEn: With the rise of pop music, jazz, and electronic music, both opera and classical music started to fade away from the public eye.
classical.translationZh: 随着流行音乐、爵士乐和电子音乐的兴起，歌剧和古典音乐都开始淡出公众视野。
classical.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

classical.sentenceEn: The most major indicator of classical music's importance in society today is the fact that much of the popular music that is currently being produced uses similar beats, harmonies, and melodies(旋律) as those that were used in some of classical music's best works.
classical.translationZh: 古典音乐在当今社会重要性的最主要指标是，当前制作的许多流行音乐使用的节拍、和声与旋律，与一些古典音乐杰作中使用的相似。
classical.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

classical.sentenceEn: What does the author think of classical music and opera in today's world?
classical.translationZh: 作者如何看待古典音乐和歌剧在当今世界的地位？

classical.sentenceEn: It might not be able to rival classical music and opera in importance for centuries to come.
classical.translationZh: 在未来几个世纪里，它可能无法在重要性上与古典音乐和歌剧相媲美。

content.sentenceEn: The experts concluded that pandas should ideally "be happy enough to thrive, but not so content that they don't want to move around and find new mates".
content.translationZh: 专家们得出结论，理想情况下，大熊猫应“足够快乐以茁壮成长，但又不能过于满足，以至于不愿活动和寻找新伴侣”。
content.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

content.sentenceEn: What use is written online content if you can't read?
content.translationZh: 如果你不识字，那么网上的文字内容又有什么用呢？

content.sentenceEn: But for as long as you want to stay safe, and for as long as you are content with where your business is right now, you will never find out.
content.translationZh: 但只要你一心求稳，只要你满足于企业当下的状况，你就永远不会知道答案。
content.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第6句

content.sentenceEn: Educational videos may deliver academic content , but they are unable to make eye contact or assess a student's level of engagement.
content.translationZh: 教育视频或许能够传递学术内容，却无法与学生进行眼神交流，也无法评估学生的投入程度。
content.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

content.sentenceEn: During the secondary school years, extending what is learned at school is positively related to academic achievement, so the content of homework becomes more important.
content.translationZh: 在中学阶段，拓展在学校学到的知识与学业成绩呈正相关，因此家庭作业的内容变得更为重要。

content.sentenceEn: Be content with what you have.

corn.translationZh: 他对农产品的热爱使他获得了南达科他州官方玉米大使的职位。

craft.sentenceEn: The craft will use the heat of re-entry to roast coffee beans as they float inside it in a pressurised tank.
craft.translationZh: 该航天器将利用重返大气层产生的热量烘焙咖啡豆，这些咖啡豆会在加压罐内漂浮。

craft.sentenceEn: Isn't this the same crowd that rails against processed junk and champions craft cooking?
craft.translationZh: 这不正是那群一边怒斥加工垃圾食品，一边推崇手工烹饪的人吗？

craft.translationZh: 制作一块招牌需要耗费数小时的时间。

craft.sentenceEn: Given that sustained social contacts have been shown to support health and a long life, those wishing to maximize the health value of crafts might consider joining a group of like-minded folks.

curriculum.sentenceEn: "Now that design education is limited in the curriculum , I'm all in favour of competitions such as Design Ventura, which helps to bring the standard curriculum to life," says Cleaver.

curriculum.sentenceEn: "We did Design Ventura in my previous school," says Liam Hourican, Finchley Catholic High School's design technology curriculum leader.
curriculum.translationZh: 芬奇利天主教高中的设计技术课程负责人利亚姆·胡里肯说：“我以前的学校开展过‘设计文图拉’项目。”

curriculum.sentenceEn: One of Design Ventura's judges says the competition adds vigour to the standard curriculum in schools.

carefully.sentenceEn: It does matter where you sit in your classroom, so choose and choose carefully .
carefully.translationZh: 在教室里的座位确实很重要，所以要仔细做出选择。
carefully.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第5句

carefully.sentenceEn: Remember that you will have to have all your certificates to hand when you are filling out the forms, as the standards are high and they'll be carefully checked before anyone will be able to sell their produce at the event.
carefully.translationZh: 请记住，填写表格时必须准备好所有证书，因为标准很高，在任何人能够在活动上销售其产品之前，这些证书都将经过仔细检查。
carefully.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第4句

carefully.sentenceEn: His carefully reasoned arguments, packed with examples, sound almost like reading a court opinion, only maybe wordier.
carefully.translationZh: 他的论证缜密合理，例证丰富，读起来几乎像是一份法庭意见书，只是可能更冗长一些。
carefully.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

carefully.sentenceEn: We found that only the concept of "negative reciprocity"—in which an employee who feels unfairly treated engages in negative behaviors, such as spending their company's money less carefully —explains these differences.
carefully.translationZh: 我们发现，只有"消极互惠"这一概念能够解释这些差异——即感到受到不公平对待的员工会做出消极行为，例如不认真对待公司资金的支出。
carefully.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

carefully.sentenceEn: Dr. Michael Yogman believes the idea that parents should carefully schedule children's time may not be helpful to their growth.
carefully.translationZh: 迈克尔·约格曼博士认为，父母应该仔细安排孩子时间的观念可能对他们的成长没有帮助。

central.sentenceEn: If the central problem is that we think of our future selves as other people, it follows that trying to identify more closely with our future selves will encourage us to make better long-term decisions.
central.translationZh: 如果核心问题在于我们将未来的自己视为他人，那么可以推断，努力与未来的自己建立更紧密的认同感将有助于我们做出更优的长期决策。

central.sentenceEn: None of these explained away the gender gap, so we applied data collected from surveys that express consumer preferences that play a central role in economic decisions, such as patience and risk avoidance.
central.translationZh: 这些因素都无法解释这种性别差异，因此我们采用了从调查中收集的数据，这些调查反映了在经济决策中起核心作用的消费者偏好，例如耐心程度和风险规避倾向。
central.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

central.sentenceEn: Researcher Andrew Jarvis and his colleagues found that 80% of coffee-growing zones in Central America and Brazil could become unsuitable by 2050, for example, while climate change will likely have "great impacts" on cocoa(可可粉) production in West Africa.
central.translationZh: 例如，研究员安德鲁·贾维斯（Andrew Jarvis）及其同事发现，到2050年，中美洲和巴西80%的咖啡种植区可能会变得不再适合种植咖啡，而气候变化也可能对西非的可可粉产量产生'重大影响'。

central.sentenceEn: In a considerable percentage of cases of debt-induced financial stress, credit cards and loans will be a central element.
central.translationZh: 在相当一部分由债务引发的经济压力案例中，信用卡和贷款往往是核心因素。
central.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

central.sentenceEn: What did the boy from Central California do according to the report?
central.translationZh: 根据报道，这位来自加利福尼亚州中部的男孩做了什么？

cognitive.sentenceEn: Taking children along to the pet shop to buy food and supplies will support their cognitive development as their passion for learning flourishes.
cognitive.translationZh: 带孩子去宠物店购买食物和用品有助于促进他们的认知发展，同时激发他们的学习热情。
cognitive.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

cognitive.sentenceEn: There are cognitive (认知的) benefits of doing things the way we did as children—building something, tearing it down, then building it up again.
cognitive.translationZh: 像我们小时候那样做事——搭建东西、拆掉它，然后再重新搭建起来——对认知能力是有好处的。
cognitive.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

cognitive.sentenceEn: Number words and their written forms transform our quantitative reasoning as they are introduced into our cognitive experience by our parents, peers and school teachers.
cognitive.translationZh: 数字词汇及其书面形式在被父母、同伴和学校老师引入我们的认知经验后，改变了我们的定量推理能力。

cognitive.sentenceEn: We must be handed the cognitive tools of numbers before we can consistently and easily recognize higher quantities.
cognitive.translationZh: 我们必须先掌握数字这一认知工具，然后才能持续且轻松地识别较大的数量。

cognitive.sentenceEn: An in-depth study of differences between human languages contributes to a true understanding of cognitive differences between cultures.
cognitive.translationZh: 对人类语言差异的深入研究有助于真正理解不同文化间的认知差异。

container.sentenceEn: "I'll inspect the product before we put it in the container and ship it over." Mr. Chan, who has been involved with the club for nearly 50 years, said that passing the dance from one generation to the next was vital.
container.translationZh: 「我会先仔细检查狮头，然后再把它装进集装箱运过来。」陈先生已经在俱乐部服务了近50年，他表示，将这项舞蹈代代相传至关重要。

container.sentenceEn: "It still has to go into a container ."
That is, in part, why smaller and softer containers have taken off—they fit into backpacks.
container.translationZh: 这也是为什么更小更软的餐盒开始流行——它们能轻松放进背包里。

container.sentenceEn: That bulky container served me well through my first and second grades, until the live-action version of 101 Dalmatians hit theaters, and I needed the newest red plastic box with characters like Pongo and Perdita on the front.
container.translationZh: 这个笨重的饭盒伴我度过了一年级和二年级，直到真人版《101忠狗》上映，我就想要最新款的红色塑料饭盒，上面印有彭哥和佩蒂塔等卡通角色。

curious.sentenceEn: Curious if the left hemispheres were indeed remaining awake to process information detected in the surrounding environment, Dr. Sasaki re-ran the experiment while presenting the sleeping participants with a mix of regularly timed beeps(蜂鸣声) of the same tone and irregular beeps of a different tone during the night.

closely.sentenceEn: But now, new research has found the cause and researchers may have come up with a solution for this frustrating traffic pattern: maintaining equal spacing between cars on the road, rather than driving so closely behind another vehicle that a collision(碰撞) is likely if that vehicle brakes suddenly.
closely.translationZh: 但现在，新的研究找到了这一现象的原因，研究人员也可能已针对这种令人沮丧的交通模式提出了解决方案：保持道路上车辆之间的均等间距，而非紧随前车行驶——当前车突然刹车时，这种近距离很可能导致碰撞。

closely.sentenceEn: But the team found that participants' brain activity while considering their future selves more closely resembled their brain activity while thinking about a current other rather than the current self.

closely.sentenceEn: If the central problem is that we think of our future selves as other people, it follows that trying to identify more closely with our future selves will encourage us to make better long-term decisions.
closely.translationZh: 如果核心问题在于我们将未来的自己视为他人，那么可以推断，努力与未来的自己建立更紧密的认同感将有助于我们做出更优的长期决策。

closely.sentenceEn: Before systems for bilateral control are installed, drivers should not follow the car in front too closely so as to reduce phantom traffic jams.
closely.translationZh: 在双边控制系统安装之前，驾驶员不应跟车太近，以减少幽灵堵车的发生。
