convenient.sentenceEn: But paying online is too convenient and I spent too much money on things I didn't need.
convenient.translationZh: 但是网上支付太方便了，我花了太多钱在不需要的东西上。
convenient.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

convenient.sentenceEn: I wouldn't need to use it every day, but I think it would be very convenient to have one for the weekends.
convenient.translationZh: 我不需要每天都用车，但我觉得周末有辆车会很方便。

convenient.sentenceEn: Will either of those times be convenient for you?

convenient.sentenceEn: Owing to the internet, it is now more convenient than ever to receive training in new skills.
convenient.translationZh: 得益于互联网，现在学习新技能比以往任何时候都更加方便。

convenient.sentenceEn: They are made convenient to mark.
convenient.translationZh: 它们被设计得便于评分

convince.sentenceEn: But the folks who run local businesses simply aren't convinced , even when their own street performs.
convince.translationZh: 但当地的企业主们就是不买账，即便他们所在的街道表现非常出色。

convince.sentenceEn: The second is to convince your present self that your future self is, in fact, still you.
convince.translationZh: 第二点是说服现在的自己，未来的自己其实依然是你。

convince.sentenceEn: The art of persuasion means convincing others to agree with your point of view or to follow your course of action.
convince.translationZh: 说服的艺术是指促使他人认同你的观点或跟随你的行动方案。

convince.sentenceEn: We persuade and get persuaded every day—we're either convincing or being convinced .
convince.translationZh: 我们每天都在说服别人，也在被别人说服——不是在说服他人，就是在被他人说服。

文章原文 · 第7段，第3句

convince.sentenceEn: People may view it as both a means to convince others and an art of communication.
convince.translationZh: 人们可能将其视为既是说服他人的手段，也是一种沟通的艺术。

coworker.sentenceEn: Effective use of persuasion skills will not only help get your coworkers excited about your ideas, it'll also help you motivate them to achieve a common goal.
coworker.translationZh: 有效运用说服技巧不仅能让同事对你的想法感到兴奋，还能激励他们为实现共同目标而努力。
coworker.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第4句

coworker.sentenceEn: Your coworkers are more likely to agree with you when they succeed alongside you.
coworker.translationZh: 当同事能与你一同取得成功时，他们更有可能认同你的观点。
coworker.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第3句

coworker.sentenceEn: When you meet with a new coworker , you immediately begin to develop an initial impression of this person.
coworker.translationZh: 当你与新同事见面时，你会立即开始形成对这个人的初步印象。
coworker.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第4句

coworker.sentenceEn: When employees log in to their computers, they're shown a picture of one of their coworkers and asked to guess that person's name.
coworker.translationZh: 当员工登录自己的电脑时，系统会向他们显示一位同事的照片，并要求他们猜出该同事的名字。

coworker.sentenceEn: When are you more likely to succeed in persuading your coworkers ?
coworker.translationZh: 什么时候你更有可能成功说服同事？

coworker.sentenceEn: He heard about it from a coworker .
coworker.translationZh: 他是从同事那里听说这件事的。

cafe.sentenceEn: What if fountains were more numerous, and tap water more clearly available in cafes , restaurants and elsewhere?
cafe.translationZh: 如果喷泉数量更多，咖啡馆、餐厅和其他地方能更方便地提供直饮水，那会怎么样呢？

cafe.sentenceEn: Working at home or in cafes , starting businesses of their own, and even launching business ventures that eventually may fail, all indicate "initiative," "creativity," and "adaptability," which are desirable qualities in today's workplace.
cafe.translationZh: 无论是居家办公、在咖啡馆工作，还是自主创业，甚至是创办最终可能失败的企业，这些都体现了"主动性"、"创造力"和"适应能力"——这些都是当今职场中备受青睐的品质。
cafe.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

cafe.sentenceEn: So, lately I've been going out to cafes occasionally.
cafe.translationZh: 所以，最近我偶尔会去咖啡馆工作。
cafe.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

cafe.sentenceEn: While remote workers help to keep the cafe full in quiet times, they can take up the valuable table space in busy periods.
cafe.translationZh: 虽然远程工作者在咖啡馆生意清淡时能帮忙撑场面，但在忙碌时段却会占用宝贵的桌位。
cafe.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第8段，第3句

cafe.sentenceEn: M: Coffee shops seem to have effectively become office spaces for so many people in this digital age, though I'm not sure how cafe owners feel about it—having so many people who go to their places to work rather than drink and eat.
cafe.translationZh: 男：在这个数字时代，咖啡馆似乎实际上已经成了很多人的办公空间，不过我不确定咖啡馆老板们对此作何感想——这么多人来他们店里是为了工作，而不是吃喝。
cafe.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

cafe.sentenceEn: Meet the woman at the Black Cat Cafe .
cafe.translationZh: 去黑猫咖啡馆见那位女士。

campaigner.sentenceEn: "It's very surprising to me," says Sam Chetan-Walsh, a political adviser at Greenpeace and campaigner against ocean plastic.
campaigner.translationZh: 绿色和平组织政治顾问兼反海洋塑料活动家山姆·切坦-沃尔什表示：“这让我非常惊讶。”

campaigner.sentenceEn: Environmental campaigners are struggling to understand why nations blessed with clean tap water grow only fonder of the bottle.
campaigner.translationZh: 环保活动人士难以理解，为何拥有清洁自来水的国家反而对瓶装水愈发青睐。

campaigner.sentenceEn: Campaigners have warned that the British government is not doing enough to prevent left-handed pupils from falling behind their peers.
campaigner.translationZh: 活动人士警告称，英国政府在防止左撇子学生落后于同龄人方面做得不够。
campaigner.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

campaigner.sentenceEn: Campaigners point out that a high percentage of the prison population is left-handed.
campaigner.translationZh: 活动人士指出，监狱人口中左撇子的比例很高。
campaigner.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第4句

campaigner.sentenceEn: Campaigners feel it's strange that children in British schools are penalized because they happen to be left-handed.
campaigner.translationZh: 活动人士认为，英国学校的孩子们仅仅因为是左撇子就受到惩罚，这很奇怪。
campaigner.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

campaigner.sentenceEn: What do the campaigners demand the department of education do?
campaigner.translationZh: 活动人士要求教育部做什么？

camping.sentenceEn: Most of the coverage of the boom in wild camping has been negative.
camping.translationZh: 关于野外露营热潮的报道大多持负面态度。
camping.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

camping.sentenceEn: Camping in public parks has now been banned for August and the early part of September because campers dump litter, human waste, and even their tents on the grassland.
camping.translationZh: 由于露营者在草地上丢弃垃圾、人类排泄物甚至帐篷，公共公园现已禁止在8月及9月初进行露营活动。
camping.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

camping.sentenceEn: Similar action has been taken even in Scotland, where camping is usually permitted on most of its open land.
camping.translationZh: 即使在通常允许在大部分开阔土地上露营的苏格兰，也采取了类似的行动。
camping.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

camping.sentenceEn: Supporters call it "wild camping "; opponents call it "illegal camping ".
camping.translationZh: 支持者称之为“野外露营”；反对者则称之为“非法露营”。
camping.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

camping.sentenceEn: Why has wild camping become popular in the UK?
camping.translationZh: 为什么野外露营在英国变得流行起来？

camping.sentenceEn: Leave no trace of their camping .

cannot.sentenceEn: The technology is being adopted so quickly that school districts cannot adequately keep up with cheating policies, or even awareness campaigns that alert students to the problem with using technology to find answers in a certain way.
cannot.translationZh: 技术的普及速度如此之快，以至于学区无法及时完善反作弊政策，甚至无法开展足够的宣传活动来提醒学生注意以特定方式使用技术查找答案的问题。
cannot.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

cannot.sentenceEn: We need a more informed way of discussing behavior that at first we cannot , or should not, begin to understand.
cannot.translationZh: 我们需要一种更有见识的方式来讨论那些起初我们无法或不应该去理解的行为。

cannot.sentenceEn: Past research has called these beliefs "mindsets(思维模式)," with a "fixed mindset" referring to the belief that people cannot change and a "growth mindset" referring to the belief that people can change.
cannot.translationZh: 以往的研究将这些信念称为“思维模式”，其中“固定型思维模式”指认为人的能力无法改变的信念，而“成长型思维模式”则指相信人可以改变自身能力的信念。

cannot.sentenceEn: However, Dr Mehmood Khan, chief scientific officer, said the company had doubled research and development spending in the past five years and was "committed to sustaining investment", adding that companies cannot cost-cut their way to increasing sales.
cannot.translationZh: 然而，首席科学官梅赫穆德·汗博士表示，公司在过去五年中已将研发支出增加了一倍，并“致力于持续投资”。他还补充道，企业不能通过削减成本来实现销售增长。
cannot.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第2句

cannot.sentenceEn: Leigh Thompson of Kellogg School of Management in Illinois warns that, "Teams are not always the answer—teams may provide insight, creativity and knowledge in a way that a person working independently cannot ; but teamwork may also lead to confusion, delay and poor decision-making."
cannot.translationZh: 伊利诺伊州凯洛格管理学院的 Leigh Thompson 警告说：“团队并非万能答案——团队或许能以个体独立工作无法实现的方式提供洞见、创造力和知识；但团队合作也可能导致混乱、延误和糟糕的决策。”

cannot.sentenceEn: She cannot stop children using smartphones.
cannot.translationZh: 如果我们阻止孩子们使用手机，就是在排斥他们所关心的东西。

capability.sentenceEn: Driver training for self-driving vehicles can help ensure that drivers fully understand system capabilities and limitations.
capability.translationZh: 自动驾驶车辆的驾驶员培训有助于确保驾驶员充分了解系统的能力和局限性。
capability.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

capability.sentenceEn: It made every effort to keep the essential capabilities of smartphones, but strip out costs and preserve battery life for people who likely have inadequate access to electricity.
capability.translationZh: 该公司竭力保留智能手机的核心功能，同时剔除不必要的成本，并延长电池续航时间——这对于那些很可能无法稳定获取电力的用户来说至关重要。
capability.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第4句

capability.sentenceEn: But Zimbardo asks: "What if the capability to act heroically is also fundamentally ordinary and available to all of us?"
capability.translationZh: 但津巴多问道：“要是见义勇为的能力从根本上来说也是一种平凡的品质，是我们每个人都具备的呢？”

capability.sentenceEn: Arrhenius calculated the capability of carbon dioxide to trap heat in the Earth's atmosphere, but other chemists disagreed.
capability.translationZh: 阿伦尼乌斯计算出了二氧化碳在地球大气中捕获热量的能力，但其他化学家对此持不同意见。
capability.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第8段，第3句

capability.sentenceEn: What should be done to help drivers fully understand system capabilities and limitations?
capability.translationZh: 应该采取什么措施来帮助驾驶员充分了解系统的能力和局限性？

capability.sentenceEn: It is an adaptable capability required of all workers.
capability.translationZh: 这是所有员工都需要具备的一种适应能力。

cigarette.sentenceEn: Social isolation poses more health risks than obesity or smoking 15 cigarettes a day, according to research published by Brigham Young University.
cigarette.translationZh: 杨百翰大学发表的研究表明，社交孤立带来的健康风险比肥胖或每天吸15支烟更大。
cigarette.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

cigarette.sentenceEn: The birds will be encouraged to clean the park through the use of a small box that delivers a small amount of bird food each time the rook deposits a cigarette end or a small piece of rubbish.
cigarette.translationZh: 园方将通过一个小盒子来鼓励这些鸟类清洁公园——每当秃鼻乌鸦放入一个烟头或一小块垃圾，盒子就会投放少量鸟食。
cigarette.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第7句

cigarette.sentenceEn: The amount of nicotine that's delivered in every cigarette is 10% higher than it was six years ago, which means that it is easier to get hooked and harder to quit.
cigarette.translationZh: 每支香烟释放的尼古丁含量比六年前高出10%，这意味着吸烟者更容易上瘾，也更难戒烟。
cigarette.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第8句

cigarette.sentenceEn: Behind the cash register at a store in downtown San Francisco, Sam Azar swiped his credit card to pay for a pack of cigarettes .
cigarette.translationZh: 在旧金山市中心一家商店的收银机后，山姆·阿扎尔刷信用卡想买一包香烟。
cigarette.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

cigarette.sentenceEn: Under the law in Massachusetts, tobacco companies have to measure the nicotine content of every type of cigarette and report the results.
cigarette.translationZh: 根据马萨诸塞州的法律，烟草公司必须测量每一种香烟的尼古丁含量并报告结果。
cigarette.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

cigarette.sentenceEn: They promised to reduce the nicotine content in cigarettes .
cigarette.translationZh: 他们曾承诺降低香烟中的尼古丁含量。

civilization.sentenceEn: But if you prefer Civilization , Total War, or X-Com, where strategy and resource management are key, then you might have more in common with managers.
civilization.translationZh: 但如果你更倾向于《文明》、《全面战争》或《幽浮》这类将战略与资源管理视为核心的游戏，那么你可能与管理者们有更多共同语言。

civilization.sentenceEn: Teams are as old as civilization , of course: even Jesus had 12 co-workers.
civilization.translationZh: 当然，团队的历史与人类文明一样悠久：就连耶稣也有12位门徒。

civilization.sentenceEn: At the top of most hills and mountains are trails leading back to civilization .
civilization.translationZh: 大多数丘陵和山脉的顶部都有通往人类居住区的小径。
civilization.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第8句

civilization.sentenceEn: Yet I, too, have resisted the idea that food shortages could bring down not only individual governments but also our global civilization .
civilization.translationZh: 然而，我也曾一直不愿相信粮食短缺不仅可能导致个别政府倒台，还可能摧毁我们的全球文明。

civilization.sentenceEn: The cost for saving our civilization would be considerably less than the world's current military spending.
civilization.translationZh: 拯救我们文明的成本将远低于世界目前的军事开支。

civilization.sentenceEn: Could Food Shortages Bring Down Civilization ?
civilization.translationZh: 粮食短缺会导致人类文明崩溃吗？

classify.sentenceEn: This type of snake is classified as a threat to humans, especially small children, as well as pets.
classify.translationZh: 这种蛇被归类为会对人类（尤其是小孩）以及宠物构成威胁的物种。
classify.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

classify.sentenceEn: In fact, 60-70 percent of the participants in the study could no longer even be classified as depressed.
classify.translationZh: 事实上，该研究中60-70%的参与者甚至已不再被归类为抑郁症患者。
classify.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

classify.sentenceEn: Countries were classified according to the respect they gave to women's economic and social rights.
classify.translationZh: 各国根据其对妇女经济和社会权利的尊重程度进行了分类。
classify.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

classify.sentenceEn: He believes that the dictionary definition of disease "is so vague that we can classify almost anything as a disease" and says the question is not whether we can, but whether we should, and to what end.
classify.translationZh: 他认为，字典中对疾病的定义"过于模糊，以至于我们几乎可以将任何事物都归类为疾病"，并表示问题不在于我们是否能够这样做，而在于我们是否应该这样做，以及这样做的目的是什么。
classify.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

classify.sentenceEn: What is Dr. Richard Pile's concern about classifying obesity as a disease?
classify.translationZh: 理查德·派尔博士对将肥胖归类为疾病有何担忧？

classify.sentenceEn: There is not enough evidence to classify it as a disease.
classify.translationZh: 没有足够的证据将其归类为疾病。

coeducational.sentenceEn: In an all-girls setting, girls are more likely to speak up frequently and make significant contributions to class than in a coeducational setting.
coeducational.translationZh: 在女子学校环境中，女生比在男女混合学校更有可能频繁发言并对课堂做出重要贡献。
coeducational.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第9句

coeducational.sentenceEn: Girls studying in a single-sex setting also earn higher scores on their College Board and Advanced Placement exams than girls who study in coeducational settings.
coeducational.translationZh: 在单性别环境中学习的女生在大学理事会考试和大学先修课程考试中也比在男女同校环境中学习的女生得分更高。
coeducational.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第10句

coeducational.sentenceEn: Numerous studies have shown that women who attend single-sex schools tend to have stronger self-confidence, better study habits and more ambitious career goals than women who attend coeducational schools.
coeducational.translationZh: 多项研究表明，就读于单一性别学校的女性往往比就读于男女混合学校的女性拥有更强的自信心、更好的学习习惯和更远大的职业目标。
coeducational.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

coeducational.sentenceEn: Girls who graduate from single-sex schools are three times more likely to become engineers than those who attend coeducational schools.
coeducational.translationZh: 毕业于单一性别学校的女生成为工程师的可能性是就读男女混合学校女生的三倍。
coeducational.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

coeducational.sentenceEn: In coeducational schools, girls are often expected to succeed only in humanities or the arts.
coeducational.translationZh: 在男女同校的学校里，人们通常期望女孩只在人文或艺术领域取得成功。
coeducational.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第5句

coeducational.sentenceEn: What advantage does the speaker say girls from single-sex schools have over those from coeducational schools?
coeducational.translationZh: 演讲者认为单性别学校的女生比男女同校的女生有什么优势？

collaboration.sentenceEn: A vast majority of people prefer collaboration and teamwork over traditional organizational structures; no one likes to be told what to do or to be pushed around.
collaboration.translationZh: 绝大多数人更喜欢协作与团队合作，而非传统的组织结构；没人喜欢被指手画脚或受人摆布。
collaboration.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

collaboration.sentenceEn: All this is done with the aim of improving workplace efficiency, collaboration and cohesion.
collaboration.translationZh: 所有这些举措都是为了提高工作效率、促进团队协作并增强凝聚力。
collaboration.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第3句

collaboration.sentenceEn: " Collaboration , negotiation, decision-making, creativity, leadership, and increased physical activity are just some of the skills and benefits children gain through play," they wrote.
collaboration.translationZh: 他们写道：'合作能力、谈判能力、决策能力、创造力、领导力以及运动量的增加，这些仅仅是孩子们通过玩耍获得的部分技能和益处。'

collaboration.sentenceEn: A new study of 12,000 workers in 17 countries by Steelcase, a furniture-maker which also does consulting, finds that the best way to ensure employees are "engaged" is to give them more control over where and how they do their work―which may mean liberating them from having to do everything in collaboration with others.
collaboration.translationZh: 家具制造商兼咨询公司Steelcase对17个国家的12,000名员工开展了一项新研究，结果发现确保员工"敬业投入"的最佳方式是给予他们更多对工作地点和工作方式的控制权——这可能意味着让他们不必凡事都要与他人协作。

collaboration.sentenceEn: Hackman (who died in 2013) noted that teams are hindered by problems of co-ordination and motivation that chip away at the benefits of collaboration .
collaboration.translationZh: 哈克曼（2013年去世）指出，团队会受到协调和激励问题的阻碍，这些问题会逐渐削弱协作带来的益处。

collaboration.sentenceEn: If not cultivated, it will not survive: "Childhood curiosity is a collaboration between child and adult. The surest way to kill it is to leave it alone."
collaboration.translationZh: 好奇心如果不加以培养，就会消失：“儿童的好奇心是孩子与成人共同作用的结果。最能肯定扼杀它的方法就是对其置之不理。”

considerable.sentenceEn: Employers argue they make considerable savings on real estate when workers shift from office to home work.
considerable.translationZh: 雇主们称，当员工从办公室转向居家办公时，他们在房地产方面节省了大量开支。
considerable.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

considerable.sentenceEn: This represents a considerable transfer of value from employees to employers.
considerable.translationZh: 这意味着价值从员工到雇主的大量转移。
considerable.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第8段，第4句

considerable.sentenceEn: In the past decade, we have seen a considerable increase in England in the number of women accepted on to full-time undergraduate degrees in science, technology, engineering and maths (Stem subjects).
considerable.translationZh: 在过去十年中，我们看到英格兰攻读科学、技术、工程和数学（Stem学科）全日制本科学位的女性人数大幅增加。
considerable.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

considerable.sentenceEn: In a considerable percentage of cases of debt-induced financial stress, credit cards and loans will be a central element.
considerable.translationZh: 在相当一部分由债务引发的经济压力案例中，信用卡和贷款往往是核心因素。
considerable.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

considerable.sentenceEn: Italy boasts more UNESCO World Heritage Sites than any other country in the world, granting it considerable power and influence within the organization.
considerable.translationZh: 意大利拥有的联合国教科文组织世界遗产数量超过世界上任何其他国家，这使其在该组织内拥有相当大的权力和影响力。

considerable.sentenceEn: It has a considerable impact on our health.
considerable.translationZh: 它对我们的健康有着相当大的影响。

convert.sentenceEn: Mr Dittoh says the idea of converting online weather reports into speech came from the farmers themselves, after a workshop in the village of Guabuligah.
convert.translationZh: 迪托先生表示，将在线天气报告转换为语音的想法源自农民自身，这一想法是在瓜布里加村的一次研讨会后提出的。

convert.sentenceEn: Mr Meteo takes the online weather forecast, converts it to a short recording in the appropriate language and makes it available on a basic phone.
convert.translationZh: 气象先生(Mr Meteo)服务会获取在线天气预报，将其转换成特定语言的简短录音，并通过普通手机提供给用户。

convert.sentenceEn: When we think of animals and plants, we have a pretty good way of dividing them into two distinct groups: one converts sunlight into energy and the other has to eat food to make its energy.
convert.translationZh: 当我们想到动物和植物时，我们有一个相当清晰的方法将它们分为两个不同的群体：一类将阳光转化为能量，另一类则必须通过进食来获取能量。
convert.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

convert.sentenceEn: It captures the energy which plants produce during photosynthesis—a process of converting sunlight into energy.
convert.translationZh: 它能够捕获植物在光合作用过程中产生的能量——光合作用是一种将阳光转化为能量的过程。
convert.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

convert.sentenceEn: It is extremely difficult to convert voice into text because of different pronunciations.
convert.translationZh: 由于发音不同，将语音转换为文本极为困难。

convert.sentenceEn: It converts fashion into something for deliberation.
convert.translationZh: 它将时尚转化为可供深思熟虑的事物。

crowded.sentenceEn: W: The bus takes twice as long and it's just as crowded .
crowded.translationZh: 公交车要花两倍的时间，而且同样拥挤。
crowded.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

crowded.sentenceEn: M: Was the rest of India crowded ?
crowded.translationZh: 男士：印度其他地方也很拥挤吗？
crowded.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第9段，第1句

crowded.sentenceEn: It was sometimes so crowded that it was difficult to walk along the streets, especially through busy markets.
crowded.translationZh: 有时候街上非常拥挤，走路都很困难，尤其是在繁忙的市场里。
crowded.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第10段，第2句

crowded.sentenceEn: M: It must have been very crowded when you were there.
crowded.translationZh: 男：你们去的时候那里一定很拥挤吧。
crowded.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第1句

crowded.sentenceEn: It is no longer as noisy and crowded as before.
crowded.translationZh: 这里不再像以前那样吵闹拥挤了。

crowdfunding.sentenceEn: To determine what separates science crowdfunding triumphs from failures, a team led by science communications scholar Mike Schafer of the University of Zurich examined the content of the webpages for 371 recent campaigns.
crowdfunding.translationZh: 为了找出科学众筹成功与失败的关键区别，苏黎世大学科学传播学学者迈克·谢弗带领的团队对近期371个众筹项目的网页内容进行了研究。
crowdfunding.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

crowdfunding.sentenceEn: For one, they use a crowdfunding platform that specializes in raising money for science, and not just any kind of project.
crowdfunding.translationZh: 其一，这些成功项目使用专门为科学研究募资的众筹平台，而非任何类型的通用平台。
crowdfunding.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

crowdfunding.sentenceEn: Crowdfunding , raising money for a project through online appeals, has taken off in recent years for everything from making movies to producing water-saving gadgets.
crowdfunding.translationZh: 众筹，即通过网络呼吁为某个项目筹集资金，近年来在各个领域蓬勃发展，从电影制作到节水设备生产应有尽有。
crowdfunding.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

crowdfunding.sentenceEn: Those are a few of the traits of successful science crowdfunding efforts that emerge from a recent study that examined nearly 400 campaigns.
crowdfunding.translationZh: 这些是近期一项对近400个众筹活动进行研究后发现的成功科学众筹项目所具备的一些特征。
crowdfunding.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

crowdfunding.sentenceEn: Crowdfunding can be part of researchers' efforts to reach the public, and people give because "they feel a connection to the person" who is doing the fundraising—not necessarily to the science.
crowdfunding.translationZh: 众筹可以成为研究人员与公众建立联系的努力的一部分，而人们之所以捐款，是因为'他们与筹款人产生了情感联系'——不一定是与科学本身。
crowdfunding.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第3句

crowdfunding.sentenceEn: What motivates people to donate in a crowdfunding campaign?
crowdfunding.translationZh: 是什么促使人们在众筹活动中捐款？

castle.sentenceEn: Around 1804, Talleyrand challenged Carême to produce a full menu for his personal castle , instructing the young baker to use local, seasonal fruits and vegetables and to avoid repeating main dishes over the course of an entire year.
castle.translationZh: 1804年左右，塔列朗向卡雷姆提出挑战，要求他为自己的私人城堡设计一套完整菜单，并指示这位年轻的糕点师必须使用当地应季蔬果，且一整年的主菜不得重复。

castle.sentenceEn: W: You know what they say—"an Englishman's home is his castle ."
castle.translationZh: 女：你知道人们怎么说的——“英国人的家就是他的城堡。”
castle.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第1句

castle.sentenceEn: A 16th century castle in Scotland is close to collapsing after lumps of soil were washed away by floods, threatening its foundations.
castle.translationZh: 苏格兰一座16世纪城堡因洪水冲蚀了大量泥土，地基岌岌可危，现已濒临倒塌。
castle.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

castle.sentenceEn: On Sunday, the castle's owner John Gordon, 76, was forced to move out of his property after the River Dee swept away about 60 feet of land, leaving the castle dangerously close to the river, according to the Scottish Daily Record.
castle.translationZh: 据《苏格兰每日纪事报》报道，76岁的城堡主人约翰·戈登(John Gordon)于周日被迫搬离自己的宅邸。此前，迪伊河(River Dee)冲毁了约60英尺的土地，使城堡濒临河岸，处境危险。
castle.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

castle.sentenceEn: Why did John Gordon move out of Abergeldie Castle ?
castle.translationZh: 约翰·戈登为什么搬出阿伯杰尔迪城堡？

castle.sentenceEn: She was eager to visit an English castle .
castle.translationZh: 她很想参观一座英国城堡。

characterize.sentenceEn: It revealed a secret about the manipulative and deceptive strategies used to make junk food more addictive and characterize the products as healthy.
characterize.translationZh: 它揭示了一个秘密，即通过操纵和欺骗性策略，使垃圾食品更让人上瘾，并将其产品包装成健康食品。
characterize.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

characterize.sentenceEn: The phenomenon of math anxiety is characterized as a general sense of feeling that the subject is hard compared with other subjects leading to a subsequent lack or loss of confidence.
characterize.translationZh: 数学焦虑现象的特征是一种普遍感觉，即与其他学科相比，数学这门学科难度较大，进而导致信心不足或丧失。
characterize.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

characterize.sentenceEn: They show a pattern of behavior characterized by a lack of control.
characterize.translationZh: 他们表现出一种以缺乏控制力为特征的行为模式。
characterize.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第4句

characterize.sentenceEn: The result is that the commitments that previously characterized the beginning of adulthood are now being delayed, and new patterns of behavior and a new stage of life are emerging for those in their twenties.
characterize.translationZh: 其结果是，那些曾标志着成年初期的承诺现在被推迟了，而新的行为模式和新的人生阶段正在二十多岁的人群中出现。

characterize.sentenceEn: The ads criticized the measure, characterizing it as a "grocery tax."
characterize.translationZh: 这些广告对这项措施提出批评，将其描述为一项“食品杂货税”。
characterize.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第2句

characterize.sentenceEn: What characterizes Japanese and Chinese foods?
characterize.translationZh: 日本和中国食物的特点是什么？

closure.sentenceEn: The poisonous snake forced the closure of the attraction last week when staff noticed the disappearance.
closure.translationZh: 上周，工作人员发现这条毒蛇失踪后，该景点被迫关闭。
closure.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

closure.sentenceEn: A pilot programme in a school district in Anderson County, South Carolina, has supplied students with electronic tablets loaded with assignments to complete in the event of a school closure .
closure.translationZh: 南卡罗来纳州安德森县学区开展了一项试点计划，为学生提供预装了学习任务的电子平板电脑，以备学校关闭时使用。

closure.sentenceEn: There are also so-called "blizzard bags", with assignments that children take home ahead of an expected snow closure .
closure.translationZh: 还有所谓的“暴雪作业包”，里面是孩子们在预期因雪停课前提回家的作业。

closure.sentenceEn: The Harvard study examined seven years of school results data and could not find any impact from snow closures .
closure.translationZh: 哈佛大学的研究调查了七年的学校成绩数据，未发现雪天停课有任何影响。

closure.sentenceEn: Students in North Carolina already have several make-up days scheduled because of school closures during Hurricane Florence, which struck in September.
closure.translationZh: 北卡罗来纳州的学生们已经安排了几个补课日，以弥补9月份飓风佛罗伦萨袭击期间学校停课造成的损失。

closure.sentenceEn: New policies adopted by many US schools require students to do online learning at home in case of a school closure .
closure.translationZh: 美国多所学校采用的新政策要求，若学校关闭，学生须在家进行在线学习。

cloth.sentenceEn: Winning entries in past years have included a make-your-own cloth kit called Dove Bunting and a threefold, wallet-sized travel game with goals at each end, called Badoiiing.
cloth.translationZh: 历年获奖作品包括一款名为“Dove Bunting”的自制布艺套件，以及一款名为“Badoiiing”的三折钱包大小旅行游戏，其两端各设有目标。

cloth.sentenceEn: In the absence of environmentally and economically feasible recycling options, fast-fashion manufacturers pump out low-quality clothes produced in high volumes that are worn only a few times and then discarded.
cloth.translationZh: 在缺乏环境和经济上均可行的回收方案的情况下，快时尚制造商大量生产低质量服装，这些服装往往只穿几次就被丢弃。
cloth.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

cloth.sentenceEn: But most of us have conflicting feelings about dressing up and feel guilty about taking the time to focus on clothes .
cloth.translationZh: 但我们大多数人对于精心打扮都怀有矛盾的心情，并且会因为花时间在穿着上而感到内疚。
cloth.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

cloth.sentenceEn: And don't worry—whether it's a plastic bento box or a cloth bag, lunch containers can still easily be covered with popular culture.
cloth.translationZh: 而且不用担心——无论是塑料便当盒还是布袋，午餐容器依然可以轻松融入流行文化元素。

cloth.sentenceEn: "You had kids in rural areas who couldn't go home from school for lunch, so bringing your lunch wrapped in a cloth , in oiled paper, in a little wooden box or something like that was a very long-standing rural tradition," says Paula Johnson, head of food history section at the Smithsonian National Museum of American History in Washington, D.C.
cloth.translationZh: 华盛顿特区史密森尼美国国家历史博物馆食品史部门负责人宝拉·约翰逊表示：“农村地区的孩子无法从学校回家吃午饭，因此用布、油纸包裹午餐，或把午餐装在小木盒之类的容器中带到学校，是一项历史悠久的农村传统。”

cloth.sentenceEn: Plastic boxes changed to lined cloth sacks, and eventually, globalism brought tiffin containers from India and bento boxes from Japan.
cloth.translationZh: 塑料饭盒逐渐被带衬里的布袋取代，最终，全球化又从印度带来了蒂芬盒，从日本带来了便当盒。

clue.sentenceEn: And where exactly should you look for these culture clues ?
clue.translationZh: 那么，究竟应该去哪里寻找这些文化线索呢？

clue.sentenceEn: They would run around looking for clues and at the end unmask the bad guy.
clue.translationZh: 他们会四处奔跑寻找线索，最后揭开坏人的面具。

clue.sentenceEn: The Great London Fire of 1666 burned many important documents that could've been a source of clues .
clue.translationZh: 1666年的伦敦大火烧毁了许多重要文件，而这些文件本可以成为线索的来源。
clue.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第21句

clue.sentenceEn: Clues about the culture of a company can be found on its website.
clue.translationZh: 关于公司文化的线索可以在其网站上找到。

clue.sentenceEn: Possible sources of clues about him were lost in a fire.
clue.translationZh: 关于他的可能线索来源都在一场大火中遗失了。

compensate.sentenceEn: This indicates that the brain is able to compensate for loss of certain brain structure.
compensate.translationZh: 这表明大脑能够补偿某些脑结构的损失。
compensate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第4句

compensate.sentenceEn: And, of course, they are compensated for it at a level that makes it worth their while.
compensate.translationZh: 当然，他们也会获得与其付出相称的报酬，让这一切变得值得。

compensate.sentenceEn: Unless employees are fully compensated , this could become a variant of parasitic(寄生的) capitalism, whereby corporate profits increasingly rely on extracting value from the public—and now personal—realm, rather than on generating new value.
compensate.translationZh: 除非员工获得充分补偿，否则这可能演变成一种寄生资本主义的变体——企业利润越来越依赖于从公共领域（如今还包括个人领域）榨取价值，而非创造新价值。
compensate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

compensate.sentenceEn: When employees are properly compensated , employers' real estate savings will be modest.
compensate.translationZh: 如果员工得到合理补偿，雇主在房地产方面的节省将十分有限。
compensate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第9段，第1句

compensate.sentenceEn: However, visitors will be compensated during the closure.
compensate.translationZh: 不过，闭馆期间将为游客提供补偿。
compensate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第8句

compensate.sentenceEn: Compensate for the Swiss manufacturer's loss.
compensate.translationZh: 补偿该瑞士制造商的损失。

confuse.sentenceEn: The phenomenon happens when thunder and lightning mix with a heavy snowstorm—sometimes causing loud claps that can be confused with explosions.
confuse.translationZh: 这种现象发生在雷声和闪电与强烈暴风雪相遇时——有时会产生响亮的爆裂声，可能被误认为是爆炸声。
confuse.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

confuse.sentenceEn: The man, who lives in the UK and is originally Italian, might have been confused by the fact that Rome is written "Roma" in Italian and "Rom" in German.
confuse.translationZh: 这位现居英国、原籍意大利的老人可能是被一个事实弄混了：罗马在意大利语中写作"Roma"，在德语中则是"Rom"。
confuse.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第1句

confuse.sentenceEn: Humility can sometimes be confused with a lack of confidence.
confuse.translationZh: 谦逊有时会被误认为是缺乏自信。
confuse.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

confuse.sentenceEn: The anti-pollution message of the reverse graffiti artists confuses city authorities since the main argument against graffiti is that it spoils the appearance of both types of property: public and private.
confuse.translationZh: 这些反向涂鸦艺术家传递的反污染信息让市政当局感到困惑，因为反对涂鸦的主要理由是它会破坏公共和私人两类财产的外观。
confuse.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

confuse.sentenceEn: Certainly, you can't wait to waste your precious hours on following the developments in a disorderly fashion and miss important deadlines, confuse interview times, or forget to follow up a result.
confuse.translationZh: 当然，你肯定不想把宝贵的时间浪费在杂乱无章地跟踪申请进展上，结果错过重要截止日期、混淆面试时间，或者忘记跟进申请结果。
confuse.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

confuse.sentenceEn: Customers given more choices are more likely to get confused .
confuse.translationZh: 选择越多的顾客越容易感到困惑。

constitute.sentenceEn: Interactive experiences may provide opportunities for children to learn about what constitutes a desirable reputation and the kinds of strategies that are effective for building a good reputation in their social environment.
constitute.translationZh: 互动体验可能为儿童提供机会，让他们了解什么是理想的声誉，以及在社交环境中建立良好声誉的有效策略。
constitute.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

constitute.sentenceEn: The traditional view of such moments is that they constitute a charming but irrelevant byproduct of youth—something to be pushed aside to make room for more important qualities, like perseverance(坚持不懈), obligation, and practicality.
constitute.translationZh: 传统观点认为，这些时刻虽令人愉悦，却只是青春无关紧要的副产品——应当将其搁置一旁，为更重要的品质腾出空间，比如坚持不懈、责任感和务实精神。

constitute.sentenceEn: What does the author think constitutes a key part of genuine education?
constitute.translationZh: 作者认为构成真正教育的关键部分是什么？

constitute.sentenceEn: CO2 emissions constitute a major threat to the environment.
constitute.translationZh: 二氧化碳排放对环境构成重大威胁。

contaminate.sentenceEn: It looks like what's at issue is less how long your food stays on the floor and much more how contaminated with bacteria that patch of floor happens to be.
contaminate.translationZh: 看来问题的关键不在于食物掉在地上多长时间，而更多地取决于那块地面的细菌污染程度。

contaminate.sentenceEn: An urban food myth contends that if food spends just a few seconds on the floor, dirt and germs won't have much of a chance to contaminate it.
contaminate.translationZh: 一个关于食物的都市传言认为，如果食物只掉在地上几秒钟，灰尘和细菌不会有太多机会污染它。

contaminate.sentenceEn: We found that the number of bacteria transferred to either kind of food didn't depend much on how long the food was in contact with the contaminated surface—whether for a few seconds or for a whole minute.
contaminate.translationZh: 我们发现，转移到两种食物中任何一种上的细菌数量，与食物接触受污染表面的时间关系不大——无论是几秒钟还是整整一分钟。

contaminate.sentenceEn: We wanted to know if the length of time food is in contact with a contaminated surface affected the rate of transfer of bacteria to the food.
contaminate.translationZh: 我们想知道食物与受污染表面接触的时间长短是否会影响细菌向食物转移的速率。

contaminate.sentenceEn: When a carpet was contaminated , less than 1% of the bacteria were transferred.
contaminate.translationZh: 当地毯受到污染时，转移到食物上的细菌不到1%。

contaminate.sentenceEn: Males are less likely than females to eat food that may have been contaminated .
contaminate.translationZh: 男性比女性更不可能食用可能已受污染的食物。

continuous.sentenceEn: Instead, they suggest it may be more of a lifelong process—a continuous , never-ending exercise that requires self-awareness and timely adjustments.
continuous.translationZh: 相反，他们认为这更可能是一个终身过程——一种持续不断、永无止境的实践，需要自我认知和适时调整。

continuous.sentenceEn: For example, a driver, annoyed after receiving continuous warnings, could decide to just ignore the message.
continuous.translationZh: 例如，一名司机在收到持续警告后感到厌烦，可能会决定直接无视这条信息。
continuous.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

continuous.sentenceEn: Continuous usage shouldn't be mistaken for endless enjoyment.
continuous.translationZh: 持续使用并不等同于乐此不疲。
continuous.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

continuous.sentenceEn: The three-stage life of full-time education, followed by continuous work, and then complete retirement may have worked for our parents or even grandparents, but it is not relevant today.
continuous.translationZh: 全日制教育、接着是持续工作、然后完全退休的三阶段人生可能曾适用于我们的父母甚至祖父母，但如今已不再适用。

continuous.sentenceEn: The mountain has been in a state of near continuous eruption for half a million years.
continuous.translationZh: 这座山近五十万年来一直处于近乎持续喷发的状态。
continuous.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

continuous.sentenceEn: Continuous fighting in the region has made surveys difficult.
continuous.translationZh: 该地区持续不断的战乱使得考察工作困难重重。
continuous.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

cooperate.sentenceEn: He could try basketball since many of the courts are indoors now and it's a sport that could help him understand team spirit while cooperating with others.
cooperate.translationZh: 他可以尝试打篮球，因为现在很多球场都是室内的，而且这是一项能帮助他在与他人合作时理解团队精神的运动。
cooperate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

cooperate.sentenceEn: It is an essential aspect of life to cooperate with other people.
cooperate.translationZh: 与他人合作是生活的重要组成部分。

cooperate.sentenceEn: It cooperates closely with local producers.
cooperate.translationZh: 它与当地生产商密切合作。

corporation.sentenceEn: Mr Ricci, who had always dreamed of being the boss of his own company, ran an in-game corporation comprising hundreds of players.
corporation.translationZh: 里奇先生一直梦想着能拥有自己的公司，他在游戏中经营着一家由数百名玩家组成的公会。

corporation.sentenceEn: Today, many large corporations stress the importance of diversity on their websites, but current statistics show that the typical manager in America still tends to be white and male.
corporation.translationZh: 如今，许多大型企业在其网站上强调多元化的重要性，但当前统计数据显示，美国的典型管理者仍然倾向于是白人和男性。
corporation.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

corporation.sentenceEn: Corporations created home pages where they could place text and graphics to sell products.
corporation.translationZh: 企业创建了网页，在上面可以放置文字和图片来销售产品。
corporation.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

corporation.sentenceEn: We will see unimaginative governments and dying corporations make disastrous decisions.
corporation.translationZh: 我们将会看到缺乏想象力的政府和濒临倒闭的企业做出灾难性的决策。

corporation.sentenceEn: What do we learn from the current statistics about diversity in large corporations ?
corporation.translationZh: 从当前的统计数据中，我们能了解到大型企业在多样性方面的哪些情况？

corporation.sentenceEn: Employers attach great importance to their corporations ' diversity.
corporation.translationZh: 雇主们高度重视公司的多元化。

crack.sentenceEn: "Maybe the best sign that Impossible Foods has cracked the code to realistic fake meat is that I couldn't stand to take another bite," she wrote.
crack.translationZh: 她写道：“或许 Impossible Foods 已经破解了制作逼真素肉的密码，最明显的迹象就是我再也吃不下去了。”
crack.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

crack.sentenceEn: The cracked tank spilled a pool of rapidly-hardening chocolate, which quickly covered the width of the road.
crack.translationZh: 破裂的油罐泄漏出一滩迅速凝固的巧克力，很快就覆盖了整个路面。
crack.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

crack.sentenceEn: And, as more high schools begin teaching it, the door could crack open for middle schools, and, perhaps inevitably, elementary schools, to incorporate a truly more multicultural curriculum.
crack.translationZh: 而且，随着越来越多的高中开始教授族裔研究课程，初中的大门也可能随之打开，小学也或许将不可避免地纳入真正更加多元文化的课程。

crack.sentenceEn: Even if they could, SimpliSafe claims that its system is always evolving, and that it varies slightly from system to system, which means there wouldn't be a universal magic formula for cracking it.
crack.translationZh: 即便他们能做到这一点，SimpliSafe公司也声称其系统一直在不断升级，而且每个系统之间都略有不同，这意味着不存在破解该系统的通用秘诀。

crack.sentenceEn: It is difficult to crack SimpliSafe as its system keeps changing.
crack.translationZh: SimpliSafe 系统难以破解，因为其系统不断变化。

crack.sentenceEn: It may shed light on people's desire to crack a secret.
crack.translationZh: 这或许能解释人们破解秘密的渴望。

cruise.sentenceEn: Horn calls this method of vehicle spacing bilateral(双边的) control, and he said it could be achieved with relatively simple modifications to the adaptive cruise control that many new cars already have.
cruise.translationZh: 霍恩将这种车辆间距控制方法称为双边控制，他表示，只需对许多新车已配备的自适应巡航控制系统进行相对简单的改装，就能实现这一目标。

cruise.sentenceEn: To address that weakness, Horn is now working with the car company Toyota to enable a form of bilateral control via modifications to existing adaptive cruise control systems, which use forward-facing sensors to judge the distance to the vehicle ahead.
cruise.translationZh: 为解决这一缺陷，霍恩目前正与丰田汽车公司合作，通过修改现有的自适应巡航控制系统来实现一种双向控制。该系统利用前向传感器判断与前车的距离。

cruise.sentenceEn: The technology is also known as autonomous cruise control.
cruise.translationZh: 该技术也被称为自适应巡航控制。

cruise.sentenceEn: Adaptive cruise control is a driver assistance technology that sets a maximum speed for vehicles and automatically slows the speed of the car when traffic is sensed in front of the vehicle.
cruise.translationZh: 自适应巡航控制是一种驾驶员辅助技术，它为车辆设定最高速度，并在感应到前方有交通状况时自动降低车速。

cruise.sentenceEn: Just beyond St. Mark's Square, a cruise ship passes, one of hundreds every year that appear over their medieval(中世纪的) surroundings.
cruise.translationZh: 就在圣马可广场不远处，一艘游轮驶过，它是每年数百艘出现在这片中世纪建筑群中的游轮之一。

cruise.sentenceEn: The passing cruise ships will undermine the foundations of the ancient buildings in Venice.
cruise.translationZh: 过往的游轮将破坏威尼斯古建筑的地基。

cyclist.sentenceEn: So while Hughes supports bike lanes — " cyclists deserve to be safe" — she sees the parking loss as an existential risk.
cyclist.translationZh: 因此，尽管休斯支持增设自行车道——“骑行者理应享有安全保障”——但她认为停车位的减少是一种生存威胁。

cyclist.sentenceEn: Cyclists loved the plan, but local business owners got very angry.
cyclist.translationZh: 骑行者们对这项计划表示赞赏，但当地企业主却感到非常愤怒。

cyclist.sentenceEn: " Cyclists and pedestrians are consumers too," notes Professor Susan Handy.
cyclist.translationZh: 苏珊·汉迪教授指出：“骑行者和行人同样也是消费者。”

cyclist.sentenceEn: When Janette Sadik-Khan was the head of New York City's Transportation Department back in the early 2000s, she oversaw a rollout(推出) of bike lanes — and got angry blowback from residents and business owners who claimed there weren't enough cyclists to justify installing lanes.
cyclist.translationZh: 21世纪初，珍妮特·萨迪克-汗（Janette Sadik-Khan）担任纽约市交通局局长时，曾主持推广自行车道。当时，此举遭到了当地居民和企业主的强烈反对，他们声称骑行者人数太少，根本不值得安装自行车道。

cyclist.sentenceEn: Now, she notes ironically, the lanes are so full of activity that opponents have turned to claiming the problem is the opposite: There are too many cyclists getting in the way of cars.
cyclist.translationZh: 她语带讽刺地指出，如今的车道非常繁忙，以至于反对者们反倒开始声称问题变了：骑行者太多了，挡住了汽车的路。

cyclist.sentenceEn: The caffeine, the equivalent of two strong cups of coffee, was sufficient to reverse this effect, with some cyclists even displaying increased eye movement speeds.
cyclist.translationZh: 而咖啡因——相当于两杯浓咖啡的量——足以逆转这种效应，有些骑行者的眼球运动速度甚至加快了。
cyclist.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第9句
